summary:

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new Barça Mamba away kit on the pitch against Elche CFThe jersey features a striking purple and yellow colorway inspired by Kobe Bryant and his Mamba MentalityThe match debut coincided directly with Kobe Bryant's birthday

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new "Barça Mamba" away kit on the pitch during a match against Elche CF. Taking the field on Kobe Bryant’s birthday, the Spanish club honored the legendary athlete by bringing his iconic spirit directly to football.The kit showcases a striking purple and yellow design, drawing direct visual inspiration from Kobe Bryant’s court-side legacy. Built around the ethos of Bryant’s signature "Mamba Mentality," the jersey translates court-side focus and relentless drive straight onto the pitch. The jerseys feature a black to purple gradient from the shoulders to the bottom of the shirt, while the shorts come in all-purple but with a subtle snakeskin texture pattern as a nod to the Black Mamba. The socks, shorts and jersey all feature the signature sheath logo which received an iridescent transformation. The team's track jacket also received a "Barça Mamba" makeover, arriving in black and purple snakeskin texture to match the aesthetic. On the other hand, the goalie jersey is entirely in a golden yellow snakeskin pattern, keeping in line with the purple and gold team Bryant spent his entire career.The FC Barcelona "Barça Mamba" away kit made its official on-pitch debut against Elche CF and are now available online at FC Barça's site. title: SKIMS' New Chief Design Officer Spent 22 Years at Supreme
summary:
SummarySKIMS hired former Supreme veteran Erin Magee as its first-ever Chief Design Officer.Simultaneously, the brand promoted Kim Schraub to the newly created role of Chief Brand Officer.On August 24, SKIMS officially announced that designer Erin Magee was hired on as the brand's first-ever Chief Design Officer, along with the promotion of Kim Schraub to Chief Brand Officer. Kim Kardashian's shapewear and apparel label made the announcement just days after Magee shared her departure from Supreme, ending her 22-year tenure at the legendary streetwear label.In an official statement provided to WWD, Magee said, "Skims has done something rare: built a brand that is both deeply personal and universal." "The commitment to design, innovation, and solutions for every body is genuinely inspiring, and I’m excited to help shape what comes next. I look forward to working alongside this talented team to push the creative boundaries of the brand and create products that people truly connect with,” she added. As SKIMS continues to expand its international presence and product mix, the Supreme veteran and Mademe founder will be tasked with supervising design and creative product direction.On August 20, Magee posted her goodbye on Instagram: “It has been the honor of a lifetime to be part of the World Famous Supreme Team." She had been with the brand since 2004, holding multiple positions throughout her tenure. In 2007, Magee launched Mademe, a women’s streetwear brand that has released collaborations with major brands like Doc Martens, Alpha Industries, and Courtney Love‘s band Hole.Kim Kardashian commented on the new appointment, saying, "I’ve admired Erin’s work for years. The way she approaches design with such a strong point of view while staying completely connected to her audience is something I deeply respect." "She understands what it means to build something that truly resonates, and I’m so excited to welcome her to Skims," she added.Stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week
summary:

Continuing its Fall 2026 seasonal rollout, Palace Skateboards is back to deliver the fourth drop of the season, headlined by an official collaboration with Fleischer Studios celebrating the iconic cartoon heroine Betty Boop. Reinterpreting historic pop-culture figures through its distinct skate-led design language, the London imprint recontextualizes the classic character across a dedicated range of apparel and accessories. Throughout the capsule, Betty Boop appears wearing her own custom take on the signature Tri-Ferg logo, set against classic Palace script, playful feline companions, heart motifs and lipstick-kissed graphics.Leading the collaborative assortment are statement varsity jackets detailed with rich chenille embroidery, alongside comfortable fleece hooded sweatshirts, woven button-down shirts and graphic T-shirts. Headwear options complete the capsule with co-branded caps and knit beanies, including a standout style featuring a knit graphic of Betty Boop wearing Palace-branded hoop earrings.Alongside the collaborative delivery, Palce also readies its fourth season delivery, focusing on rugged utility and versatile transitional layering pieces. The core offering is anchored by the Big Ripstop Jacket and matching Big Ripstop Joggers, constructed from durable technical fabrics in Army Black, Army Navy and Army Olive colorways. Joining the military-influenced aesthetic is the Dove Stamp Waffle Long-Sleeve, which arrives in Army Olive, Snow Camo and Black to provide breathable textured warmth for shifting temperatures.Rounding out the mainline delivery is the Legacy collection, featuring a coordinated polo, hoodie, and jogger set offered in timeless Black, Navy, and Woodland Camo colorways. Palace Skateboards’ Betty Boop capsule and Fall 2026 Drop 4 will release in-store and online on August 28, 2026, at 11 a.m. BST /EDT across the UK, Europe, the US and Canada. title: 「タナカ ダイスケ」5年目の現在地　ものづくりの美学、G-DRAGON衣装制作のきっかけも
summary: FASHIONSNAPでは、ファッション領域を中心に日々さまざまな新世代のつくり手を取材している。そして気がつくのは、いつの時代も新たな才能を持つ若者がカルチャーの担い手であるということ。そこで、今日から始まる「次世代クリエイター」特集では、ファッションとその周縁を取り巻くアップカミングなクリエイターたちにフォーカスしていく。 　まずは、設立5年以下で独自の世界観を持ち、今後の活躍に注目が寄せられるファッションデザイナー3人を紹介。トップバッターに選んだのは「タナカ ダイスケ（tanakadaisuke）」を手掛ける田中大資だ。設立5年でショーの開催や国内ファッションアワードの受賞、パリでの展示会の実施など堅実な歩みを進めている。卸先は国内16店舗、海外5店舗と、ビジネス面はまだまだ伸び代があるが、繊細な刺繍やビジューを散りばめた装飾は舞台映えが抜群で、BIGBANGのG-DRAGONを筆頭にK-POPや著名アーティストがステージ衣装に次々と起用。エンタメの世界からも熱視線を集め存在感を放つ。特定の誰かのための衣装制作と、ブランドとして多くの人に届けるクリエイションの両輪が相乗効果を生み出し独自路線を走る。 　大人になってもときめきを忘れずにファッションを楽しむ心に寄り添い、混沌とした毎日を生きるための“おまじない”のような服でコアなファンを増やすタナカ ダイスケ。5年の節目を迎え、変わらないことと変わったこと、10年目に向けたブランドらしさとの向き合い方を聞いた。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: Two Souls Bound by Impulse: The Cinematic Poetry of Valentino’s “Vendetta”
summary:
Summary

Romain Gavras directs Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård in a 35mm campaign film for Valentino Beauty's newest fragrance, Vendetta.Vendetta is made up of two scents: the tuberose-driven "Vendetta Donna" alongside the ginger and cinnamon-based "Vendetta Uomo."

Valentino Beauty unveils a magnetic return to passion with its new prestige fragrance duo, Vendetta, brought to life in a campaign film starring Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård.Directed by Romain Gavras and photographed by Inez & Vinoodh, the cinematic narrative unfolds on 35mm film as an intimate, instinctive escape set against the driving rhythms of Pet Shop Boys’ "It’s a Sin." Set between sunlit highways and hushed, shadowed interiors, Johnson and Skarsgård embody two rebellious souls bound by an undeniable energy, orbiting one another in a shared pursuit of freedom.Throughout the film, Valentino's signature red weaves through key visual moments - from flowing dresses to subtle gestures - acting as a visceral symbol of sensuality, intensity, and the tension of what is yet to unfold. The duo expresses this passion through two distinct olfactory signatures. "Vendetta Donna," composed by Dominique Ropion and Andrew Everett, is a floral gourmand woody scent centering on a luminous, carnal Tuberose Osmobloom™. It opens with a burst of juicy red orange nectar before settling into a warm, lingering sandalwood base.Its counterpart, "Vendetta Uomo", crafted by Marie Salamagne, is a woody spicy gourmand built on textural contrasts. Opening with a shot of Peruvian ginger CO2 extract and fresh Italian citrus, the scent unfolds into an addictive heart of cinnamon liquor before anchoring itself in structured patchouli and carnal woods.Matching the intensity of the scent narrative, the bottle design captures pure couture architecture. Sculpted with a bold graphic "V" motif integrated into the glass silhouette, each vessel features a pleated cap inspired by the delicate fabric folds of Valentino garments. The deep crimson juice of "Vendetta Donna" and the rich cognac amber of "Vendetta Uomo" glow through the structured glass, visually completing the story of magnetic connection.The new fragrances are available via Valentino Beauty's website and boutiques. title: Nike Unveils Official 'One Piece' Footwear and Apparel Collection
summary:
Summary

Nike has partnered with the 'One Piece' manga franchise for an extensive footwear and apparel capsuleThe collection features three Devil Fruit-inspired expressions of the Nike Air Max Plus alongside co-branded jerseys t-shirts caps and a vestThe release debuts through regional pop-ups in Tokyo on September 4 followed by a global launch on September 25

Nike has officially announced an upcoming footwear and apparel collection inspired by the world-renowned manga franchise One Piece. Blending sportswear heritage with global pop culture, the partnership translates key lore from the storyline into specialized footwear executions and co-branded apparel.At the center of the collection are three distinct colorways of the Nike Air Max Plus featuring completely retooled uppers exclusive to the partnership. Each design takes direct inspiration from specific Devil Fruits found within the storyline: the Gomu Gomu no Mi, Ope Ope no Mi, and Mera Mera no Mi. "We were inspired by the superhuman abilities that are unleashed when One Piece characters eat the Devil Fruits, much like the feeling an athlete has when they put on a pair of Nikes," said Nick Remlinger, GM of Energy Gaming at Nike.The apparel lineup complements the footwear with Air Max Plus jerseys and caps pulled directly from the Nike archives. T-shirts incorporate classic Nike ad styling merged with manga illustrations alongside the Jolly Roger graphic drawn by Monkey D. Luffy. The range is rounded out by a specialized vest inspired by the lore of the Devil Fruits, which render those who eat them unable to swim.The Nike x One Piece collection debuts through special pop-up and retail experiences starting September 4, 2026, in Tokyo, releasing at HBX on September 12, followed by a global release on September 25, 2026, via SNKRS.

Palace Skateboards has officially announced its third retail location in South Korea, Palace Seoul Lotte World Mall, opening alongside an exclusive commemorative apparel collection. Situated inside Lotte World Mall near the 555-metre Lotte World Tower in Jamsil, the 142.57-square-metre space merges the London skate label’s retail identity with traditional local architecture.Continuing a design narrative that previously referenced royal Korean palaces, Moon Jars, and London's brutalist Southbank skate scene, the new flagship turns to Seoul’s historic Jongmyo Shrine for visual inspiration. The store’s linear layout echoes the shrine's horizontal continuity, framed by round concrete columns with corduroy-fluted finishes, stained teak paneling, mirrored walls, and camouflage marble. Decorative installations include a faceted mirror-glass skateboard deck display, an infinity mirrored 3D LED tri-ferg, a freestanding LED video wall, UK DPM camouflage carpeting, and Palace’s signature oversized bulldog sculpture.To celebrate the grand opening, Palace is releasing a store-exclusive collection of limited-edition apparel and accessories. The release features technical shell jackets, shorts, hoodies, and T-shirts finished with Olympic-inspired graphics that pay homage to nearby Seoul Olympic Park in Songpa District. Additional graphic details integrate Lotty and Lorry, the official raccoon mascots of Lotte World Adventure.The Palace Skateboards Seoul Lotte World Mall store and its exclusive launch capsule officially open on Saturday, August 22, 2026.PALACE SKATEBOARDS SEOULLotte World Mall 1F300 Olympic-roSongpa-gu, Seoul

title: Fugazi Draws Crowds for $5 Shoes & Supreme Chief Creative Steps Down in This Week's Top Fashion News
summary:
SummarySupreme’s CCO departed after 22 years, while Palace Skateboards and Reese Cooper expanded with new retail spaces.Fugazi dropped a canceled collaboration with Vans for just $5.Reebok debuted 3D-printed kicks, and Awake NY delivered bootleg-inspired luxury Air Jordan 6s.How a Cancelled Fugazi x Vans Collab Led to $5 USD ShoesWhen Vans canceled its highly anticipated collaboration with streetwear label Fugazi, the brand took matters into its own hands with a bold move. The initial partnership drew heavy backlash from fans of the anti-consumerist punk band also named Fugazi, who deemed the project tone-deaf. Vans executives quickly terminated the deal to respect the band's ethos. Unfazed, the clothing brand launched a discreet, cash-only drop from a branded van in New York and Los Angeles. Despite the corporate ax, the shoes were sold to massive, eager crowds for a mere $5 USD. Fugazi cheekily blurred out the footwear in all release photos, adding a final rebellious wink to the defunct campaign.Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 YearsErin Magee stepped down as Supreme’s Chief Creative Officer, closing a monumental 22-year chapter with the New York streetwear giant. The designer, who joined the label in 2004, announced her departure on Instagram. Magee played a pivotal role in shaping Supreme's identity, but she's now expected to shift focus to Mademe, her women’s streetwear label founded in 2007. Her exit adds another layer of uncertainty to Supreme’s recent instability, which included multiple corporate buyouts and the controversial departure of former Creative Director Tremaine Emory. With the creative director position already vacant, Magee’s departure leaves significant questions about who may steer the iconic brand's future vision.Palace Skateboards to Open Third South Korean Store in SeoulPalace Skateboards has announced plans to officially open its third offline store in South Korea with Palace Jamsil on August 22. Nestled inside the capital city's largest shopping mall. The store's interior reportedly draws architectural inspiration from a South Korean UNESCO World Heritage Site. To celebrate the flagship opening, Palace will release an exclusive collection available only on-site at the Jamsil location. The expansion plan further solidifies the label's growing following within the Asian streetwear market.Reese Cooper Opens RC Outdoor Supply Retail Store in Los AngelesReese Cooper has expanded his retail footprint by opening the first physical RC Outdoor Supply store in Los Angeles. Located in Silverlake, the 806-square-foot flagship was designed in collaboration with creative studio PlayLab Inc. to serve as the home base for the designer's outdoor-focused apparel and RCI footwear. The brick-and-mortar space brings Cooper's function-driven pieces engineered for harsh environments into an IRL environment — including his taped-seam shell jackets, insulated outerwear, and trademarked Hook hardware. Operating daily, the outpost brings his blend of Americana heritage and technical trail readiness directly to the Southern California community.Reebok and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Question 96/26Reebok and Zellerfeld have come together, transforming Allen Iverson’s first signature sneaker into the 3D-printed Question 96/26. This futuristic style kicks off the 30th-anniversary celebrations for the original Reebok Question released in 1996. The refreshed and remodelled footwear maintained the classic sweeping proportions and iconic honeycomb cushioning geometry, but updated with a fluid, digitally native structure. Released in "Lilac" and "Stone," the shoes brought the recognizable heritage silhouette into the growing 3D-printed ecosystem. The Reebok Question 96/26 drops in limited quantities on August 25, 2026, at 12 p.m. ET, available exclusively via Zellerfeld for $169 USD.Awake NY and Jordan Brand Flip Bootleg Culture for AJ6 CollaborationJordan Brand and Awake NY celebrated the Air Jordan 6's 35th anniversary with the release of a new capsule deeply inspired by New York bootleg culture. Inspired by founder Angelo Baque’s early memories of street market knockoffs, the design subverted the sneaker's codes with exaggerated color blocking and unconventional stitching. Despite the bootleg aesthetic, the craftsmanship remained strictly premium, utilizing Saffiano leather, Game Royal nubuck, and vibrant Infrared 23 detailing. The collaboration also featured a full ready-to-wear apparel capsule, including a matching tracksuit and an elevated polo. An online EQL raffle for the Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 sneaker opens on August 23, 2026. The full capsule will officially release on August 24, 2026, dropping online via Awake NY as well as in-store at its NYC location.

Diptyque has unveiled its Les Rituels de Soin Collection, a holistic body care line that will officially release next month. Inspired by ancient bathing customs, the collection is designed to reconnect body and soul through sensorial rituals that blend fragrance, texture and gesture.Overseen by perfumer Nathalie Cetto, every formula features up to 100% natural ingredients, transforming each fragrance into a scientifically measured active ingredient that enhances emotional well-being. Anchoring the range are two core rituals: the energizing Morning Ritual - led by the Le Matin vegetable-noted candle, an awakening Dry Body Brush and a bergamot and sweet almond milk Nurturing Cleansing Gel - and the soothing Evening Ritual, which centers around the chamomile-infused Le Soir candle, a roasted barley and rose Rich Soothing Body Balm, and a contour-sculpting Ceramic Gua Sha.Complementing the care products, Diptyque has introduced a series of decorative objects that extend the rituals into everyday life. These include lacquered wood trays, tissue boxes, and mirror boxes illustrated by Julie Serre, as well as biscuit porcelain apothecary jars crafted by Manufacture de Couleuvre. The Maison also debuts terrazzo pocket mirrors made from recycled oyster shells and a two-tone Oval Travel Bag in recycled canvas, reinforcing its commitment to sustainability.The Les Rituels de Soin Collection will be available through Diptyque boutiques and online starting September 2026.

Tailoring is executed with classic woolen tweeds and earth-toned windowpane checks seen in double-breasted jackets and matching trousers. title: Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 Years
summary:
SummaryErin Magee stepped down as Supreme's Chief Creative Officer after 22 years, likely to focus on her growing label, Mademe.Her exit adds to Supreme's recent instability, following Tremaine Emory's controversial resignation and successive corporate buyouts.On August 20, Supreme Chief Creative Officer Erin Magee announced her departure via Instagram after more than two decades at the NYC-born streetwear label. “It has been the honor of a lifetime to be part of the World Famous Supreme Team,” she shared in the post.Magee had been with the brand since 2004, having held several positions during her tenure. Since the brand’s early days, she has been behind the development and direction of some of the brand's most iconic pieces and collaborative projects. In 2007, Magee launched women's streetwear brand Mademe, which she may very well center her focus on now that she has departed from Supreme. The Mademe label has continued to grow in the 2020s, capturing major partnerships with brands like Doc Martens, Alpha Industries, and Courtney Love's band Hole. View this post on Instagram A post shared by erin_mademe (@erin_mademe)The news is only the latest reshuffle to come from the brand in recent years, including its 2020 VF Corp acquisition, designer Tremaine Emory’s sudden departure from his new Creative Director role in 2023, and VF’s sale of the label to EssilorLuxottica in 2024. Emory's departure, only a year after his appointment, was particularly controversial as he cited internal discrimination as the reason for his decision. Since then, the brand has left the Creative Director position without replacement. Supreme has yet to announce who will fill Magee's long-held CCO role.Stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: UNION Subverts Industrial Uniforms for New Dickies Collaboration

UNION has joined forces with Dickies for a collaborative Fall/Winter 2026 capsule titled "INVERSE." True to its name, the collection reimagines Dickies' classic utilitarian silhouettes by flipping traditional garment construction inside out. The design language highlights exposed seams, inverted fabric textures, and contrast stitching across Dickies' signature heavy-duty cotton twill. By subverting industrial uniforms into elevated street staples, the joint project bridges Union’s refined West Coast streetwear aesthetic with Dickies' century-old workwear legacy.The "INVERSE" capsule centers around a set of co-branded workwear suits, featuring unstructured chore jackets and wide-leg Eisenhower-style tops paired with matching double-knee work pants and relaxed trousers. Each piece is finished with dual logo patches, exposed interior taping, and subtle contrast stitching that emphasizes the collection's inside-out theme. The lineup is further complemented by graphic T-shirts and daily layering tops.The UNION x Dickies “INVERSE” collection officially releases today via UNION's official webstore and in-store across UNION flagship locations in Los Angeles and Tokyo.

title: Bode Is in the Peak of Its Cowboy Era for SS27
summary:
SummaryBode’s SS27 collection reimagines the 1865-1890s American cowboy era, blending ornate Western styles with contemporary, wearable staples.Signature details include playful cow prints, subtle rodeo motifs, heavy suede and leather fringing, and intricately decorated denim.As a continuation of the FW26 Rodeo Bodeo concept, Bode designer Emily Adams Bode Aujla explores signature Western styles with a timeless touch for SS27. Centering on “the peak of the American cowboy era” (circa 1865 - 1890s), the latest range features strong cowboy cultural references combined with the ornate embellishments and durable materials of the time.Standing out immediately is a women's look featuring a brown cow print bikini and jacket, a high-exposure contemporary number that grounds this time-hopping collection in the present. The pattern continues in a men's look comprising a jacket and shorts outlined by matching green trims and styled with a green striped tee. Other fabrics incorporate cowboy motifs like rope tricks and horses in colorful patterns. Some executions are more discreet than others: a gray animal print is superimposed with blue cowboys in mid-lasso form, which are only visible with a closer glimpse.Suede and leather fringe play a major role in imbuing the broader collection with a cowboy feel. Brown leather riding pants are emphasized with a short fringe finish up the legs, while multiple jackets, including a red blouson with a decorative yoke, feature more dramatic fringe moments. Denim also continues as a main staple for SS27, featured in a camp-collar long-sleeve adorned with star rivets at the pocket and a chore jacket, decorated with folk-style trims around the collar, pockets, and cuffs.Styled with a certain ease true to the present, the overall collection goes heavy on Western-inspiration through statement pieces while grounding it in a foundation of wearable staples like the t-shirts, trousers, and tailored ensembles.See the full Bode SS27 collection in the gallery above.

title: 8 Drops You Don't Want to Miss This Week
summary:
With another week upon us, we have yet another installment of our product drops series.This week’s lineup of drops kicks off with Supreme officially launching its FW26 season with a massive collection featuring a Jeff Hamilton Box Logo leather jacket and a chromed-out motor scooter. Palace Skateboards follows with its Fall 2026 Drop 3, blending an archive baseball collaboration alongside Ebbets Field Flannels with biker-inspired moto gear. Drake's OVO reconnects with the UFC for a fighter-inspired apparel capsule fronted by Canadian welterweight Mike Malott, while Shinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD doubles down on motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics for its moody FW26 delivery. Technical outerwear takes center stage as Descente unveils its thermal-bonded "Mizusawa Down" FW26 range built at its newly rebuilt factory, while PLEASURES explores subcultural nostalgia and transitional layering in its "Somewhere In Between" collection. C2H4® translates 1950s mid-century interior design into contemporary urban menswear, and closing out the week, Bear Walker teams up with ONE PIECE for custom-carved, holographic Devil Fruit blindbox skate decks.Check out this week’s 8 drops you don’t want to miss below.Supreme FW26 Collection Drop 1Supreme officially kicks off its Fall/Winter 2026 season with the reveal of its complete apparel and accessories lineup. The expansive collection balances premium fabrications and fine art co-signs with heavy-duty outerwear, headlined by a standout Jeff Hamilton leather jacket adorned with an all-over patchwork appliqué of historical Box Logos. Alongside reimagined streetwear staples and artistic collaborations—including works by Rita Ackermann and Masato Kawajo—the brand pushes its accessory game to new heights with offerings like a chromed-out motor scooter and a Kodak Super 8 camera. Supreme’s FW26 collection will begin its initial rollout on August 20 globally through the brand's physical flagships and official webstore, followed by a release in Asia.Palace Skateboards Fall 2026 Drop 3Palace Skateboards continues its Fall 2026 rollout with its third delivery, anchored by a nostalgic collaboration with heritage sportswear manufacturer Ebbets Field Flannels. The capsule honors the archive graphics of historic baseball franchises like the Negro League's New York Cubans and Japan's Sankei Atoms across jersey-lined coach jackets, mesh V-necks, and wool ballcaps. Meanwhile, the mainline drop leans heavily into biker-inspired racing aesthetics and religious iconography, highlighted by the padded "Highway to Heaven" moto jacket and the neon wire-embroidered "Pray For Us" hoodie. Palace’s Fall 2026 Drop 3 is set to release on August 21 online and instores across the UK, EU, US and Canada, followed by an August 22 launch in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, and China.OVO x UFC CollaborationDrake's October's Very Own (OVO) and the UFC have reconnected for their second collaborative apparel collection, enlisting Canadian UFC welterweight Mike Malott to front the official campaign. The lifestyle capsule is designed to seamlessly bridge the intense world of mixed martial arts with premium contemporary fashion. The offering features an array of co-branded garments, including hoodies, athletic jerseys, graphic T-shirts, and long-sleeve shirts that combine fighter-inspired artwork with OVO's signature owl iconography. The highly anticipated OVO x UFC 2026 capsule is scheduled to release on August 21 through OVO’s physical flagships and official online store.NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 CollectionShinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD is gearing up for the colder months with its comprehensive Fall/Winter 2026 collection, doubling down on the brand’s signature fusion of motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics. Grounded in a moody palette of charcoal, faded indigo, and rich earth tones, the seasonal wardrobe is led by a heavy-duty outerwear selection that includes leather jackets, wool coats, and elaborately embroidered bombers. Staying true to its "Craft With Pride" ethos, the brand rounds out the collection with distressed knit sweaters, versatile button-ups, and adaptable bottom wear. The NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 collection officially launches on August 22 via the brand’s online store and select global retailers.Descente “Mizusawa Down” FW26 Collection Japanese technical label Descente has unveiled its premium “Mizusawa Down” Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear range, crafted at its newly rebuilt Mizusawa factory. The collection introduces a refined evolution of its signature non-quilted, thermal-bonded down jackets, engineered to merge minimalist urban styling with extreme weather performance. Flagship models like the "MOUNTAINEER," "ANCHOR," and "SHUTTLE-L" return with modernized shell fabrics and reworked functional details, joined by the debut of the limited, cold-weather "EXPEDITION" variant. An advance pre-order phase for the Descente "Mizusawa Down" FW26 collection begins on August 21 through the brand's official webstore, with subsequent global rollouts scheduled for September 18 and October 23.PLEASURES FALL 2026 CollectionLos Angeles-based streetwear imprint PLEASURES explores the tension between the familiar and the unknown in its Fall 2026 collection, aptly titled "Somewhere In Between." The seasonal delivery blends subcultural nostalgia with contemporary, relaxed fits, focusing heavily on versatile layering for the transitional weather. The comprehensive wardrobe highlights textured outerwear, tactile knitwear, relaxed denim, and the brand's signature bold graphic apparel. The PLEASURES "Somewhere In Between" Fall 2026 collection is available to shop now directly through the brand'sofficial website and select global stockists.C2H4® 012 Collection Fall DeliveryLos Angeles and Shanghai-based menswear label C2H4® expands its continuous, year-round 012 Collection with a new fall delivery that translates mid-century interior design into contemporary fashion. Drawing aesthetic cues from 1950s and 1960s architecture, the collection balances retro nostalgia with modern urban utility across refined, durable silhouettes designed to age naturally with the wearer. Standout garments include the Mechanic Washed Engineer Jacket, Moccasin Memory Textured Henley, and the Lake Tahoe Cabin Gentle Padded Vest. With prices ranging from $90 to $1,450 USD, the C2H4® 012 Collection fall delivery is available to purchase now via the brand's global webstore.Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate DeckSkateboarding artist Bear Walker has teamed up with the legendary anime franchise ONE PIECE for an exclusive Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate Deck collection. Merging high-end craftsmanship with pop culture, the custom-carved wooden decks feature holographic finishes and highlight key characters like Luffy, Chopper, and Blackbeard alongside their respective Devil Fruits. The mystery blind box packaging adds a thrilling element of surprise for collectors, with ultra-rare 1-of-1 chase boards hidden throughout the release. Priced at $110 USD each, the Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit collection officially drops on August 21 via Bear Walker's webstore and Pensacola flagship location.

title: 「ユニクロ」の歴史が分かるタグ変遷と見分け方
summary: 誰もが知るあのブランドの歴史を「タグ」の変遷で紐解く連載。今回取り上げるのは、日本を代表するカジュアルウェアブランド「ユニクロ（UNIQLO）」です。 　特に、創業から2000年代前半までのアイテムは「オールドユニクロ」として、古着市場で少しずつ注目を集めています。ただし、ユニクロのタグは時代ごとに名称も年代も情報が入り乱れており、正確とはいえない情報も少なくありません。 　今回はオールドユニクロを収集し、当時のチラシやカタログ、ファーストリテイリングの有価証券報告書などの一次資料からブランドの「商品史」を独自に研究してきたミフラさんに、各年代のタグの特徴を見分け方を伺いました。 ミフラ （mihra） オールドユニクロ研究家 オールドユニクロの収集家・研究家。セカンドストリートで偶然古いタグのユニクロを見つけたことがきっかけに、オールドユニクロにのめり込む。現在は、リサイクルショップなどで昔のユニクロを探して購入することを趣味のひとつとしている。ネット上に体系的な資料が少ないことから一次資料を集め、年代ごとのタグや商品の変遷を独自に調査・発信している。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: D.S. & Durga Bottles the Nostalgic Magic of 2000s New York Romance With “Ain’t That Sweet”
summary:
Cult-favorite Brooklyn fragrance house D.S. & Durga is stepping into uncharted olfactive territory. Founded in 2008 by self-taught perfumer and musician David (D.S.) Seth Moltz and architect-turned-creative director Kavi (Durga) Moltz, the brand has built a global following by transforming unconventional ideas into rich, narrative-driven perfumes. Now, the duo is tackling a notoriously polarizing scent category with its newly unveiled "Ain’t That Sweet" — an amber fragrance billed as the ultimate gourmand for people who don’t usually wear gourmands.Inspired by the optimism of young love and the magnetic pull of NYC in the early 2000s, the scent bottles the energy of late-night romance and the annual migration of dreamers arriving in the city to find their purpose. The fragrance paints an intimate picture of a note left between lovers alongside a slice of dark, malty date cake and a glass of golden milk waiting on a kitchen counter for a midnight return. Built on top notes of myrrh and Sri Lankan cinnamon, the scent moves through a heart of date, praline and lily before drying down into a warm, grounded base of condensed milk, bourbon vanilla and nutmeg.True to D.S. & Durga’s ethos, the new release is treated as a multifaceted work of art. David, who views perfume and music as intertwined invisible art forms, composed an original "party soul" track specifically to score the campaign, while Kavi spearheaded a bold new packaging design utilizing the brand's signature "peach concrete" hue.Gourmands can often be polarizing or overly sugary, but you’ve described "Ain’t That Sweet" as a gourmand for people who don’t usually wear gourmands. How did you balance notes like date cake and golden milk to keep it sophisticated rather than overly sweet?David Moltz: I balanced the decadent date cake fumes with materials that are grounding and perfumey — musk, patchouli, real vanilla absolute. Sweet but not too sweet.The scent is rooted in early 2000s New York and the DIY Brooklyn scene. What specific memories or cultural moments from that era were you trying to bottle with this release?David: Well, we are rooted in that scene for sure! "Ain't That Sweet" recalls young romance in the city (now and then). The possibility of finding love. The early stages of courtship. The note left behind before texting all day was a thing. There is something timeless about your twenties. Think of how many of our favorite songs, poems and stories come from people in their 20s. You have an open channel to the Universe and you don’t even know it. I’m not trying to be nostalgic for a time now gone — I’m more interested in bottling that energy of romantic nights and possibility in the city for new people to wear and make their own stories with.“That thrill in the beginning when you’re excited to go over the top for your new love… It feels otherworldly… "Ain’t That Sweet" is just like that feeling.” - David Moltz, Co-FounderYou paint a very vivid picture with this scent — a note left between lovers, a midnight return, date cake and golden milk waiting on the counter. Why was this quiet, intimate late-night scene the ultimate hero image for "Ain't That Sweet"?David: That thrill in the beginning when you are excited to go over the top for your new love — bake a cake, write a song, surprise them. You have to go to work, but you know you’re coming home to sleep next to them. It feels otherworldly when it happens to you. "Ain't That Sweet" is warm and familiar, just like that feeling.Where do you see "Ain't That Sweet" fitting into the evolving landscape of how people wear fragrance today?David: It’s a great fume for nights out. Attractive and heavy with a rich, spicy sillage. I actually showed this and 50 other things to a few people whose opinion I really respect, and this one got the most “OMGs.” Shout out Mr. Cologne!How does your background as a musician shape the way you compose fragrance? And how did these two creative processes converge when making "Ain't That Sweet"?David: Music and perfume are both invisible art forms. They have a real structure, but you can’t see them. So you interact with both in a very immediate and mysterious way. You see and feel things out of nowhere. I write music and make perfumes almost instinctively. Stuff flows through and I try to organize the word, sound, or scent in a way that is most faithful to the idea.I’ve been really into scoring the scents lately. I make singles or EPs for each launch now, and I make sound vignettes for the ads and socials. For "Ain't That Sweet", I made a sort of party soul track that became the theme of the campaign. So now the fumes are even more linked to sound than, say, just making a playlist with someone else’s music.Kavi, what inspired the new packaging design? How does the artwork and packaging shape the fragrance experience and scent storytelling?Kavi Moltz: We wanted to go bolder. The worlds of the fragrances are all so rich, colorful and full of life. Adding images and bringing our “peach concrete” color to the forefront does a better job at showing the depth of each perfume. We also wanted the box to be useful, so it’s more of a keepsake — a minimally branded, sturdy box that can hold things in its second life.D.S. & Durga's "Ain't That Sweet" launches on August 25, 2026, via the brand's official webstore and select retailers. Working with Central Saint Martins has brought to life the connections between fashion and racing, allowing us to see our history reinterpreted in fresh and unexpected ways.”Meanwhile, Fabio Piras, Course Leader for MA Fashion at Central Saint Martins, said, “At Central Saint Martins, we believe the most valuable learning happens when students are challenged to apply their creativity in real-world contexts. title: REVERSIBLE Is Making Designer Shopping Smarter With Its "Luxury, For Less" Campaign
summary:
Anyone who has ever opened fifteen browser tabs to track down one pair of designer sneakers at the right price, in the right size, from a retailer that actually ships to their country, knows the problem. REVERSIBLE, the fashion discovery and shopping platform, was built to collapse that process into a single screen. The platform aggregates real-time inventory, pricing and availability from over 500 retail partners worldwide, and its current "Luxury, For Less" campaign sharpens that proposition further by spotlighting exclusive markdowns across some of fashion's most coveted labels.One Platform, Hundreds of RetailersOnline designer shopping has a visibility problem. The same coveted piece can appear at wildly different price points depending on which retailer, boutique or resale marketplace lists it, and most shoppers never see the full picture. REVERSIBLE was built to close that gap. The platform aggregates real-time inventory, pricing, shipping details, return policies and active promotions from authorized retailers and selected boutiques worldwide, currently spanning over 500 partners and more than one million styles from labels like Balenciaga, sacai, Rick Owens, Gucci and Guidi. Rather than functioning as another storefront, REVERSIBLE operates as a discovery layer that sits on top of the existing retail landscape, pulling everything into one searchable, comparable view.Price Comparison That Actually WorksREVERSIBLE's core utility is its multi-retailer price comparison. On any product page, shoppers can see every available listing for a given item, broken down by retailer, size and price. A pair of Miu Miu Gymnasium sneakers, for example, might sit at $494 USD from one shop and $1,100 USD from another depending on size and stock. A Loewe cotton cargo trouser listed across nine retailers will display each store's pricing and inventory in a single scroll. The platform also tracks price history over selectable windows of one month, three months, six months, one year or all time, charted against the original retail price. If a piece that retailed at $1,650 USD is now listed at $495 USD after weeks near $900 USD, that trajectory is immediately visible, turning what would otherwise be an impulse buy into an informed decision.Sizing, Stock and Alerts Across Every ListingBeyond price, REVERSIBLE surfaces sizing and availability data from every connected retailer on one page. Shoppers can toggle between EU and US sizing, view which stores carry their size and compare what each charges for it. If a preferred size is sold out, the platform's Watchlist feature lets users set restock alerts through a bell icon on any listing. Once a matching item reappears, whether from a restock or a newly listed retailer, REVERSIBLE sends a push notification. For high-demand designer pieces where popular sizes move within hours, this turns passive browsing into active monitoring.A Smoother Path From Inspiration to PurchaseREVERSIBLE extends beyond traditional search with tools designed to make discovery feel less transactional. Its visual search feature lets users snap a photo or upload an image to find matching or similar products across the platform's catalog, pulling results with full pricing, sizing and retailer data attached. The platform's Lookbook feature adds a social layer: when users tag products in outfit posts or moodboards, that content appears on the product's page, giving other shoppers real styling context from the REVERSIBLE community. Together, these tools compress what used to be a multi-tab, multi-app process into a single, scrollable journey from inspiration to checkout."Luxury, For Less": The CampaignREVERSIBLE's current "Luxury, For Less" campaign brings all of these tools into focus by spotlighting exclusive sales and markdowns across the platform's retail network. The campaign funnels shoppers directly into discounted inventory from some of the world's most sought-after designer brands, and from there, REVERSIBLE's comparison engine, price history charts and restock alerts do the rest. It is less a traditional sale event and more an invitation to use the platform the way it was designed to be used: find what you want, see every option, and buy it for less.REVERSIBLE's "Luxury, For Less" campaign is live now. Head to REVERSIBLE to explore the platform's full suite of discovery and comparison tools.

Artist Philip Gefaell has unveiled the custom Ash Charizard Ring, a bespoke piece of high jewelry commissioned to celebrate 30 years of Pokémon. Created for one of the franchise's leading card resellers and collectors, the custom ring transforms the bond between Ash Ketchum and Charizard into an intricate wearable sculpture.The structure of the ring is crafted from 18K white gold featuring a soft sunblasted matte finish, establishing an industrial, futuristic texture. Sculpted in highly polished 18K rose gold, Charizard wraps around a central "A" emblem—referencing Ash Ketchum—appearing to break out from the architectural frame of the piece. The body of the ring is set with natural VVS diamonds and features a digitized, slightly distressed geometric pattern that continues the visual language Gefaell developed for a previous Poké Ball Pendant commission.Completing the project, Gefaell created a custom presentation box designed specifically as an extension of the artwork. Built using a specialized Pokémon-inspired design language, the packaging incorporates Charizard motifs and a Poké Ball reference to turn the unboxing moment into an integral part of the experience.

title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week

Summary

Palace Skateboards’ third delivery for Fall 2026 is led by an Ebbets Field Flannels collaboration spanning outerwear, jerseys and headwear.Palace's own "Highway to Heaven" moto jacket, "Pray For Us" hoodie, "Plaice" knit sweater and "Supplex" shell cap fill out the drop.The collaborative lineup is fronted by New York Cubans and Sankei Atoms coach jackets alongside polymesh V-necks and wool ballcaps.

Continuing its weekly seasonal rollout, Palace Skateboards returns with its third delivery for its Fall 2026 collection, anchored by a major collaboration with heritage sportswear manufacturer Ebbets Field Flannels alongside a distinct selection of mainline apparel. The mainline drop leans heavily into biker-inspired racing graphics and religious iconography. Headlining the core offering is the "Highway to Heaven" jacket and matching long-sleeve jersey - available in black and pink colorways - featuring padded moto-style paneling, "24:7 POWER" lettering, and praying Virgin Mary line graphics. The theme continues with the "Pray For Us" hoodie with neon wire-style embroidery, while the "Plaice" knit sweater and matching mesh trucker cap feature a clever Palace-branded spin on the traditional Ichthys emblem. Lightweight headwear options, such as the oval-logo Supplex Shell Cap, round out the mainline assortment.Complementing the core delivery, the Palace x Ebbets Field Flannels capsule honors the archive graphics of two historic baseball franchises: the Negro League’s New York Cubans and Japan's historic Sankei Atoms. The accompanying campaign by Cuban-American photographer David Cabrera is shot on location in New York City, capturing Palace pro skater Shawn Powers alongside a cast of local NYC personalities to ground the historic baseball theme in authentic street culture.The actual collaborative lineup is led by jersey-lined nylon coach jackets outfitted with snap closures, drawstrings, and authentic team patches. Key pieces for the New York Cubans lineup include a grey wool ballcap with an interlocked "NY" monogram, a heavy fleece hoodie, and a polymesh V-neck jersey. Meanwhile, the Sankei Atoms collection showcases iconic Astro Boy graphics across bright blue and red mesh V-necks, graphic hoodies, cut-and-sew tees, and two-tone wool ballcaps. Palace Skateboards’ Fall 2026 Drop 3 and the Ebbets Field Flannels capsule will release through a staggered global rollout. The drop begins online and in-store on August 21, 2026, at 11 a.m. BST/EDT across the UK, Europe, US and Canada. A subsequent release will follow on , August 22, 2026, at 11 a.m. local time in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong and China, with South Korea receiving the release at noon on the same day.
